original.name: KPI / Kosten
original.contract: cost inventory, currency/price year, discount, scenario/time weights and selection
original.positive: same total after exact unit+weight reconciliation
original.negative: omits time weight or double-counts CAPEX
original.comparison: E3 sampled values possible; E4 not inferred

typed_symbols: opex EUR/h; duration h; scenario probability dimensionless; capex EUR; price basis EUR:real:2025; year index; discount policy
synthetic_input: opex=[20,40] EUR/h, dt=[1/2,3/2] h, one scenario p=1; capex 100 EUR at time zero; discount factor 1 synthetic
external_obligations: KPI=sum_s p_s sum_t dt_t*opex_s,t + one capex contribution; apply authorized discount factors at designated times; unique underlying contribution support
independent_analytical_oracle: 10+60+100=170 EUR. Omitting dt gives 160 (dimensionally wrong); adding same capex again gives 270.
observables: typed KPI output, cost items, weights, selection, contribution ledger
verification: Separate static checks, finite witness oracle and scientific proof obligations; original oracle unchanged
